name: javelin-ai-assistant
description: An AI-powered coding assistant - concise, direct, and technically accurate

commands.title: Revert to My Last Message (undo chat and files)

enumDescriptions: Your own fine-tuned Javelin model, served locally (no API key)
Keyless local model via Ollama — code never leaves your machine
Groq cloud inference (needs an API key)
javelin.provider.markdownDescription: Where the model runs. **Javelin (fine-tuned)** serves your own trained weights and needs no API key. See [docs/TRAINING.md](docs/TRAINING.md).

javelin.baseUrl.description: Override the provider endpoint base URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1). Leave blank for the provider default.

enumDescriptions: Javelin Coder — your own Javelin model running locally. Build it once with `npm run model:local`. Keyless, offline, on your machine.
Javelin Coder 80B — the flagship Javelin model. Requires the 'Javelin (fine-tuned)' provider, and must be trained + merged first (run `npm run models` to check).
Javelin (latest) — your trained Javelin weights, served locally.
Qwen2.5 Coder 7B — keyless local model via Ollama (default).
Qwen2.5 Coder 14B — larger local coder model.
DeepSeek Coder V2 16B — local coder model.
Llama 3.3 70B — Groq cloud (fast, needs an API key).
javelin.model.markdownDescription: Model id to use. **Javelin Coder 80B** is Javelin's own flagship model — select the **Javelin (fine-tuned)** provider for it, and run `npm run models` to confirm it has actually been trained and merged. Local models are Ollama tags (e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:7b`).

javelin.groqApiKey.markdownDescription: API key for cloud providers (free at https://console.groq.com/keys). Prefer the **Javelin AI: Set API Key** command — it stores the key encrypted instead of in plain text here. Not needed for the local provider.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every file change and every non-allowlisted command.
Apply edits without asking; deleting a file and unusual commands still confirm first.
Do everything unattended — plan, edit, delete, run. Only catastrophic commands stay blocked.
javelin.autonomy.markdownDescription: How much Javelin may do without stopping to ask. **Auto-edit** applies code edits without prompting, but still confirms **file deletions** and unusual commands — so a delete can never happen just because you turned on fast editing. **Full** lets the agent complete a whole task end to end, including deleting files, taking a checkpoint at the start instead of pausing. Catastrophic commands (`rm -rf /`, disk formatting, etc.) are always refused.

javelin.agentAutoApproveSafeCommands.description: Run test/build/lint commands without an approval prompt. Ignored when javelin.autonomy is auto-edit or full.

javelin.agentMaxSteps.description: Maximum number of agent steps before it stops and reports back.

javelin.agentLiveEditInEditor.description: Apply the agent's edits through a real, visible editor so you watch the code change in place (instead of a silent disk write).

javelin.agentAnimateEdits.description: Animate added lines so the agent's edits look like they are being typed into the editor. Turn off to snap edits in instantly.

javelin.agentEditSpeedMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between animated chunks when the agent types an edit. Lower is faster.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
